edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: A high calcium score is a direct readout of cumulative coronary plaque burden, which makes it informative for overall mortality as well as heart attacks.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2023 Su cohort in Transplant Direct, which ties high coronary artery calcium score to all-cause mortality in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
